skill_name: Suggest a method for teaching English as a second language to children.
workflow: One method for teaching English as a second language to children is to use a combination of activities and approaches, such as storytelling, role-playing, games, visual aids, and music. Storytelling can help children learn basic vocabulary and grammar and provide a fun and engaging way to learn. Role-playing can help children build confidence and practice using the language in different scenarios. Games can make learning fun and help build relationships between the students and the teacher.
